offence_note: Attempt to obtain firearm, transfer ammunition, conspiracy to traffic marijuana
sentence_quote: the trial judge sentenced the appellant to 4 years and 9 months’ imprisonment, less 5 months credit, resulting in a sentence of 4 years and 4 months’ imprisonment.
note: Firearm sentence 4y plus 9m consecutive for marijuana; appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Aggravated assault by shooting, pointing firearm, firearm possession, threats
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Durley to 6 years' imprisonment less pre-sentence custody credit (510 days).
note: Joint recommendation accepted; victim surcharge waived; weapons prohibition for life.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave, allow the Crown's appeal and substitute a sentence of four years imprisonment.
note: Two years raised to four; Huddart J.A. dissented; trial restitution of $45,000 not addressed by majority.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence the accused to a period of 12 months' imprisonment. In addition, the accused would be placed on probation for a period of 12 months from the date of his release from prison.
note: Credit one for one; victim surcharge waived; lifetime weapons prohibition.

sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced Mr. MacKay to a custodial term of 38 months and made certain ancillary orders.
note: Ancillary orders unspecified; offender already serving eight-year sentence for other offences.

offence_note: Armed robbery, weapons offences, possession of stolen property, obstruct justice
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to a total of 5 years and 6 months in addition to 21 and a half months spent in pre-trial custody.
note: Unclear whether 5y6m is before or after pre-trial credit; consecutive weapons-while-prohibited sentence; co-accused tried.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted and the serious violent offence designation is quashed.
note: Youth sentence length not shown; only serious violent offence designation quashed.

sentence_quote: The appellant appeals from the 16-year period of parole ineligibility fixed by the trial judge in relation to the life sentence imposed for second degree murder.
note: Appeal dismissed; no mitigating factors like those in McKnight.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing bodily harm; failure to remain at scene
sentence_quote: the 18-month sentence imposed on him on the first count of dangerous driving causing bodily harm, and the 6-month sentence on the second count of failure to remain at the scene of the accident, to be served consecutively.
note: 18 months plus 6 months consecutive; victim surcharge set aside; cognitive evidence considered but not given weight.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon (wrench) on security guard
sentence_quote: For this offence, I am sentencing you to 15 months' imprisonment. With time served, that sentence will effectively be one day.
note: Cree; Gladue report waived; surcharge declined; lifetime s. 109 order.

offence_note: Possession of handgun, cocaine for trafficking, proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would accordingly allow the appeal, exclude the evidence on a fresh s. 24(2) analysis, and substitute acquittals on all counts.
note: Majority allows appeal and enters acquittals; dissent would have upheld three-year sentence.
